verdict.rationale: The evidence implies a screenshot-plus-vision-model approach: any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint, a mirroring link, a self-calibrating AssistiveTouch pointer, and separate planner and actor models. Run replay draws taps and swipes on the screenshots, and traces of screenshots and actions can be exported, so misclicks can be inspected. However, the evidence never states how UI elements are actually located (raw coordinates vs. OCR vs. set-of-marks vs. accessibility tree); the user-editable prompts are the only hint at the grounding logic. Missing for 10: an explicit description of the element-locating method, how model outputs map to pointer coordinates, any calibration or grounding accuracy notes, and independent corroboration.
